title: Serialize sales order proposal draft edits submission and cancellation
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Use existing IErpDbContext transactions and deterministic compatible source sales-order then request row locks. Create captures authoritative source header/details consistently under source lock, rereads source availability and live permission before number/save. Edit/submit/cancel serialize on immutable stored source and request identity, reread current status and authorization under lock. Reuse existing canonical sales-order lock protocol; do not change source UpdatedAt merely to lock. No source status/quantity/amount, downstream documents, schema or permission writes.

Submitting freezes one complete positive validated proposed snapshot; simultaneous edit/submit has one consistent committed outcome and controlled stale loser. Cancel preserves first committed reason/time and history; later competing requests cannot replace it. Validate proposal rounded quantities/amounts with existing rules/EF precision before mutation; immutable source snapshot columns and original source id remain unchanged on edits. Failed detail replacement or snapshot write rolls back all proposal mutations; SQL exceptions are controlled, not exposed. Do not add approve/apply actions or silently refresh historical source snapshots.

Real SQL two independent connection tests cover edit versus submit, competing cancel, create versus source cancellation/ownership change, permission revocation and forced detail/write failure with zero partial changes. Assert source snapshot consistency, complete frozen lines, original cancellation reason, parent/commercial/inventory/finance unchanged. Relevant proposal authorization and lifecycle units plus safe Release/full unit and accurate browser blockers.

implementation_evidence: SalesOrderChangeRequestService CreateDraftAsync loads source then separately captures snapshot/numbers/saves; UpdateDraftAsync replaces proposal details and SubmitAsync/CancelAsync read status then save without transaction or row locks. Concurrent draft-edit/submit can freeze inconsistent proposal lines, competing cancellation can overwrite original reason, and source changes can race snapshot capture. Prior ERP047 and preceding authorization task do not provide atomic lifecycle.
